import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")


def main():
    # Define paths based on benchmark setup
    input_path = "./input"
    submission_dir = "./submission"

    # Ensure directories exist
    os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)

    # Load data
    train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(input_path, "train.csv"))
    test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(input_path, "test.csv"))
    sample_sub = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(input_path, "sample_submission.csv"))

    # Identify columns
    id_col = "id"
    target_col = "species"

    # Separate features
    all_cols = train_df.columns.tolist()
    feature_cols = [c for c in all_cols if c not in [id_col, target_col]]

    # Prepare Training Data
    X_train = train_df[feature_cols]
    y_train_str = train_df[target_col]

    # Determine Class Mapping
    unique_classes = sorted(train_df[target_col].unique().tolist())
    class_to_idx = {cls: idx for idx, cls in enumerate(unique_classes)}
    idx_to_class = {idx: cls for cls, idx in class_to_idx.items()}

    # Convert targets to integer indices for model
    y_train = train_df[target_col].map(class_to_idx)

    # Prepare Test Data
    X_test = test_df[feature_cols]
    test_ids = test_df[id_col].tolist()

    # Prepare Validation Data (Holdout)
    # Split training data to simulate unseen data for metric calculation
    X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val_idx = train_test_split(
        X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
    )

    # Initialize and train model
    model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(n_estimators=200, random_state=42, verbose=-1)
    model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)  # FIXED: Use y_tr instead of y_val_idx

    # Validate on held-out split
    y_val_pred_proba = model.predict_proba(X_val)
    # Use integer labels for consistency with predict_proba column alignment
    val_logloss = log_loss(y_val_idx.values, y_val_pred_proba)

    print(f"Hold-out Multi-Class Log-Loss: {val_logloss:.6f}")

    # Prepare Submission Predictions
    # Predict probabilities on full test set
    test_proba = model.predict_proba(X_test)

    # Construct submission dataframe
    # Order columns to match sample_submission
    submission_cols = sample_sub.columns.tolist()
    # Keep 'id' as first, others are species
    species_cols = submission_cols[1:]

    submission_df = pd.DataFrame({id_col: test_ids}, columns=[id_col] + species_cols)

    # Fill probabilities ensuring column names match expected species names
    # model.classes_ are aligned with unique_classes (sorted)
    for spec_name in species_cols:
        if spec_name in class_to_idx:
            idx = class_to_idx[spec_name]
            submission_df[spec_name] = test_proba[:, idx]
        else:
            # Fallback for safety, though should not occur if train covers test labels
            submission_df[spec_name] = 0.0

    # Save submission
    submission_df.to_csv(os.path.join(submission_dir, "submission.csv"), index=False)
    print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
